title: Mathematics, B.A. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Companion to the already-built Mathematics, B.S. (General Mathematics option) -- fully reuses math_catalog.json/cmpsc_catalog.json/stat_catalog.json. Two variable-credit rows (MATH 250 or 251 '3-4cr', a Supporting Course '3-4cr') resolved to their lower value throughout, matching the bulletin's own stated 119-121cr range at its 119cr floor. World Language Level 1-3 and 'Supporting Course (Chosen in consultation with an academic adviser)' modeled as generic slots, same convention as CASBA/GEOBA. 'PSU 16' modeled as 'First-Year Seminar (PSU 016)', same label already used in the B.S. build. Computed 8-semester total (119cr) matches the bulletin's own stated range's floor exactly. Post-parens-fix re-scrape revealed STAT 200's real prereq is MATH 21 (a placement threshold below Calc I that a MATH-140-track student has already tested past, but the bulletin's prereq text never says so explicitly), and MATH 21 itself has its own real chain (MATH 21 needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3) -- none of MATH 3/4/21 were in the plan, permanently blocking STAT 200. Added MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), and MATH 21 (Semester 3) explicitly to complete the real chain, matching the fix used for the companion Mathematics, B.S. plan.

items.notes: Wired 2026-08-26 per the Mathematics department's own real 'Supporting Courses' rule (science.psu.edu/math/undergraduate/math-major/supporting-courses): "any baccalaureate degree course EXCEPT" a named denylist (CAS 126; ENGL/ESL 4 or 5; LLED 5 or 10; STAT 100; CMPSC 100 or 102; MATH 2/3/4/10/30-38/81-83/200/201) plus MATH 21/22/26/40/41 (allowed only if taken in sequence prior to MATH 140, which this plan's own sequence never does) and any course that duplicates one already completed (the department's own MATH 110-duplicates-MATH-140 example). open_elective lets the engine actually recommend a real course here instead of an unfillable placeholder, while refusing every course the department's own page disallows.

items.label: MATH 400-Level Course
items.notes: Wired 2026-08-26 per the live bulletin's General Mathematics option text (bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/mathematics-bs/): "6 credits of 400-level MATH courses except 401, 405, 406, 410, 418, 441, 470, 471 (max 2 credits of MATH 400)". Restricted to MATH itself (elective_exclude_prefixes covers every other department this plan loads) via open_elective, excluding the bulletin's named denylist and MATH 400 outright (it's a 1-credit repeatable seminar capped at 2 total credits, which a single 3-credit slot pick can't model correctly, so it's excluded here rather than risk overcounting it).
